basic_details.job_title: CSIR CFTRI Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR CFTRI) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Project Associate – I post under advertisement number PAT 65/2026. Eligible candidates holding a Masters in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Molecular Biology/Botany/Zoology/Genetics or related subject can apply online. The engagement carries a pay of Rs. 31,000 or Rs. 25,000 plus HRA for a tenure initially for a period up to SIX months and extendable up to March 2028 or till the end of the project duration. The selection process involves shortlisting by a designated committee followed by

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may submit online application only at https://patcell.cftri.res.in along with necessary attachments of the certificates in support of date of birth, caste, qualification/experience etc.
Ensure the application is submitted on or before 01.11.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
important_instructions: Relaxation in age limit for the candidates belonging to the category of SC/ST/PwBD/Women and the category of OBC shall be 05 years and 03 years respectively. The Engagement under any of the above position(s) shall be on behalf of the sponsoring agency and shall be temporary and co-terminus with the tenure of the Project or 06 years whichever is earlier, and does not provide any right/claim for regularization for a permanent post. If already the candidate is working in CSIR/CSIR-CFTRI a “NOC” from the current PI is mandatory for applying for the aforementioned project. In a case, if selected, Engagement under this project would be made only after submission of ‘No Dues Certificate’ and resignation from the previous project. The maximum duration, for which Project staff could be engaged in different projects taken together, will be 6 years. CANVASSING IN ANY FORM AND/OR BRINGING ANY INFLUENCE POLITICAL OR OTHERWISE WILL BE TREATED AS A DISQUALIFICATION FOR THE POST.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post code FIR070407.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only those candidates who have already acquired the essential qualification & their results have been declared are eligible to apply. Result awaited /Final semester appeared or appearing are not eligible to apply for any post. Applicants who have completed the total tenure of 6 years in any of the CSIR Lab/Instt. as Project Staff are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for the aforesaid positions.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Molecular Biology/Botany/Zoology/Genetics or related subject from recognized University
rows.desirable: Experience in recombinant DNA techniques, enzyme assays, enzyme purification and characterization.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for a period up to SIX months and may be extendable up to March 2028 based on the requirement or till the end of the project duration, whichever is earlier at CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru, Karnataka. The engagement is co-terminus with the term of the Project. Stipend is (a) Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA for those candidates who have qualified National Eligibility Tests (CSIRUGC NET, GATE etc.) and (b) Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above.
